sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Higher Education Research Endowment Fund Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT IX OF 2004
ACT IX OF 2004
NORTH‑WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE HIGHER EDUCATION RESEARCH ENDOWMENT FUND ACT, 2004
An Act to provide for the establishment of Endowment Fund
in the North‑West Frontier Province.
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 28th October, 2004]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis.1/2004/28951, dated 28‑10‑2004.‑‑The
North‑West Frontier Province Higher Education Research Endowment Fund
Bill, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North‑West
Frontier Province on 12th October, 2004 and assented to by the Governor of the
North‑West Frontier Province on 20th October, 2004 is hereby published as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North‑West Frontier Province.
Whereas it is expedient to
provide for the establishment of Endowment Fund in the North‑West
Frontier Province, for carrying out research activities in public sector
Universities;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.--‑(1) This Act may be called the North‑West
Frontier Province Higher Education Research Endowment Fund Act. 2004.
(2) It extends to whole of the
North‑West Frontier Province.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Whereas it is expedient to

It is hereby enacted as follows:
3. Establishment of Endowment
Fund.--‑(1) As soon as may be, after the commencement of this Act,
Government shall establish a Fund to be known as the North‑West Frontier
Province Higher Education Research Endowment Fund.
(2) The Fund shall be established
with an initial capital of fifty million rupees having been allocated out of
current budget of Government.
(3) The amount credited to the
Fund shall be distinct and operated upon strictly in accordance with the
provisions of this Act and in the manner prescribed.

Whereas it is expedient to
provide for the establishment of Endowment Fund in the North‑West
Frontier Province, for carrying out research activities in public sector
Universities;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
4. Purpose of Fund.‑‑‑(1)
The amount credited into Fund shall be utilized for financing research in the
natural and social sciences in all the public sector Universities.
(2) Research grants shall be made
out of the Fund to the students and faculty members in the prescribed manner.
(3) Scholarships shall be awarded
out' of the. Fund to the deserving students for carrying out research in the
Universities.
(4) Research grant shall also be
made to deserving scholars and scientists from the private sector and,
retired/experienced Government servants having a Science and Technology and
Development Economics backgrounds.

responsible to submit monthly statement of receipt and payments to the
Additional Secretary; Higher Education Department who will maintain tile

(2) No amount from the Fund shall
